summary: Frontend-only label & field audit for web-parity (Iteration 31). All requested labels validated via live UI + source review. New Bill 'Assign staff' placeholder confirmed live. History filter chip 'QR / Online' confirmed live. issues: statLabel style applies text-transform (renders 'QR / ONLINE' uppercase) — matches previous UPI casing so no regression, but note web app uses proper case 'QR / Online'. Optional: remove uppercase text-transform to fully match web casing.

action_items: OPTIONAL polish: On manage/cash-closing.tsx, statLabel style has text-transform:uppercase which renders 'QR / Online' as 'QR / ONLINE'. To exactly match web casing, drop text-transform on that KPI label (or on statLabel entirely). Non-blocking.

OPTIONAL: In manage/appointments.tsx line 526, the empty picker chip reads 'Any' — spec suggested 'Any staff'. Recommend updating chip text to 'Any staff' to match list display fallback 'a.beautician_name || "Any staff"' at line 198.

OPTIONAL: manage/beauticians.tsx line 136 role-picker chip still lists 'Beautician' as one of the role options; this is a valid role name, not a screen label, so leave as-is unless product intent changes.
critical_code_review_comments: services.tsx modal is well-structured; Variable price toggle correctly gates 'Suggested add-on (₹)' input; Cancel/Save row uses proper flex layout.

new-bill.tsx uses testID='pay-mode-split' — good for future testing. Split hint 'QR / Online (balance)' at line 612 is conditionally rendered inside IIFE — works but obscured below sticky footer on small viewports (visual concern only).
cash-closing.tsx statLabel style textTransform:uppercase overrides intended casing — minor style drift from web (see design_issues).
